content.text: Nɑ̀ n yenibɑ kpuro wɑ, nɛn tororɑ rɑ kɑrewɑ
kpɑ nɑ n diirimɔ.
I swɑɑ dɑkio i Gusunɔn nɔɔ nɔ ɡe ɡɑ kukirimɔ nɡe ɡurɑ.
Gɑ nɔɔrɑ bɑɑmɑ wɔllɔ.
Mɑ ɡuru mɑɑkinu nu bɑllimɔ hɑnduniɑn ɡoonu nnɛ sɔɔ.
Guru mɑɑki nin biru, Gusunɔn nɔɔ ɡɑ rɑ nɔɔre kɑ dɑm
kpɑ yɑnde ɡuru mɑɑki kpɑɑnu nu sɔ̃ɔsirɑ.
Ù n ɡbɑ̃rɑ, tɔmbu bɑ rɑ biti soorewɑ.
Gɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnɑ u kuɑ mi, ni tɔnu kun kpɛ̃ u tubu.
U rɑ ɡuru kpenu sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, nu nɛɛyɔ.
U rɑ mɑɑ ɡurɑn tii sɔ̃ u nɛɛ, yu nɛɛyɔ kɑ dɑm.
U rɑ de tɔmbu kpuro bu ben sɔmburu yɔ̃rɑsiɑ ɡurɑ yen sɔ̃,
kpɑ bu ɡiɑ mɑ wiyɑ u ye kpuro mɔ̀.
Bɑɑ kɑ ɡbeeku yɛɛyɔ u rɑ dewɑ yi dɑ yi kpunɑ yin wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Guru woo bɔkɔ ɡɑ rɑ nɛwɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑn di,
kpɑ purɑ yu nɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di.
Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u rɑ nim wom wure,
kpɑ mu bɔbiɑ nɡe ɡuru kperu.
Wiyɑ u rɑ de kɑkoru tɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɡuru wiru sɔɔ,
kpɑ u tu yɑrinɑsiɑ kɑ ɡuru mɑɑkinu sɑnnu.
U rɑ tu ɡɔsiewɑ nɡe mɛ u kĩ.
Kpɑ tu ko nɡe mɛ u ɡeruɑ hɑnduniɑ sɔɔ.
Tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bokuru te u rɑ kɑ tɔmbu sɛɛyɑsie
ǹ kun mɛ u kɑ bu win kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yoobu, ɑ yenibɑ kpuro lɑɑkɑri koowo.
A Yinni Gusunɔn sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu mɛɛrio ɑ wɑ.
A yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ Gusunɔ u rɑ nu dendisinɛ,
kpɑ u de ɡuru mɑɑkinu nu bɑlli ɡuru winu sɔɔ?
A yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ ɡuru winu nu kɑ bwɛ̃ɛ wɔllɔ?
Wi u yenin bweseru kuɑ, win yɛ̃ru tɑ yibɑ mɑm mɑm.
Woo ɡɑ̀ n sweemɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑn di,
yɑm susurɑ rɑ nun ko, ɑ̀ n wunɛn yɑ̃nu doke.
Kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ wɔllu tɛriɑ nɡe wi,
kpɑ tɑ n dɑm mɔ nɡe diɡi ye bɑ kuɑ kɑ sisu?
A sun sɔ̃ɔsio ye n weenɛ su Gusunɔ sɔ̃.
Domi sɑ ǹ wɑ ye sɑ ko nùn wisi bɛsɛn yɛ̃ru sɑrirun sɔ̃.
Tilɑsiwɑ bu kɑ nùn sɔ̃ nɑ̀ n ɡɑri ɡeruɑ?
Tilɑsiwɑ bu kɑ nùn nɔɔsiɑ ye nɑ ɡeruɑ?
Wee u rɑ de yɑm mu tĩrɑ subɑru sɔɔ,
kpɑ ɡuru winu nu n sɔ̃ɔ beruɑ.
Adɑmɑ u rɑ de woo ɡu se ɡu wɔllu dɛɛrɑsiɑ.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ yɑm bururɑm mu koo nɑ sɑɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm ɡeu ɡiɑn di,
kpɑ mu n nùn sikerenɛ kɑ nɑnum bɑkɑm.
Sɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ su Dɑm kpuroɡii tubu.
Domi win dɑm mu kpɑ̃.
U rɑ mɑɑ kpuro ko dee dee.
U ku rɑ wi u ɡem mɔ dɑm dɔre.
Mɛyɑ u ku rɑ mɑɑ be bɑ tii mɛɛrɑ bwisiɡibu ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ n weenɛ tɔmbu bu nùn nɑsiɑ.
